title: The Week in AgriFoodTech: John Deere + The Reservoir, AI-powered regen ag, 'Zipotle' delivery
content: Ag equipment giant John Deere announced this week it will be the exclusive OEM partner of The Reservoir, an ag robotics incubation hub...
raw_content: Ag equipment giant John Deere announced this week it will be the exclusive OEM partner of The Reservoir, an ag robotics incubation hub slated to open in October in California. India-based agtech startup Cropin, meanwhile, is applying some AI-powered field intelligence to potato growing in Europe thanks to a financial boost from EIT. Elsewhere, the Good Food Institute got a new leader, Northern Ireland’s science sector got monetary a boost from the UK Industrial Strategy, and Chipotle showed off a new way of delivering burritos.
